今天.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang bù xiǎng sàn bù
今天.en: I don't feel like taking a walk this morning.
今天.es: Esta mañana, no me apetece darme un paseo.

今天.zh: 今天下午我有两个小时的英语课和两个小时的汉语课。
今天.pinyin: Jīn tiān xià wǔ wǒ yǒu liǎng gè xiǎo shí de yīng yǔ kè hé liǎng gè xiǎo shí de hàn yǔ kè
今天.en: This afternoon I have English class for two hours and then two hours of Chinese.
今天.es: Esta tarde tengo dos horas de clase de inglés y dos horas de clase de chino.

今天.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǒ tóu tòng yù liè
今天.en: I have a bad headache today.
今天.es: Hoy tengo un fuerte dolor de cabeza.

菜.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan rì běn cài ma
Yǒu méi yǒu shèn má hǎo cài tuī jiè
菜.en: What would you recommend we eat?

菜.zh: 没有甚么比你做的菜更好吃了。
菜.pinyin: Méi yǒu shèn má bǐ nǐ zuò de cài gèng hǎo chī le
菜.en: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.

菜.zh: 大家说这家饭馆儿的菜又好吃又便宜。
菜.pinyin: Dà jiā shuō zhè jiā fàn guǎnr de cài yòu hǎo chī yòu pián yi
菜.en: Everyone says the food in this restaurant is both delicious and inexpensive.

告诉.zh: 你能告诉我这是什么吗？
告诉.pinyin: Nǐ néng gào su wǒ zhè shì shén me ma
告诉.en: Can you tell me what this is?

告诉.zh: 告诉我你对湘南做了什么。
告诉.pinyin: Gào su wǒ nǐ duì xiāng nán zuò le shén me
告诉.en: Tell me what you did to Shounan.
告诉.es: Dime qué le has hecho a Shounan.

告诉.zh: 他告诉我什么时候该说是。
告诉.pinyin: Tā gào su wǒ shén me shí hou gāi shuō shì
告诉.en: He told me when to say yes.
告诉.es: Él me dijo cuándo decir sí.

告诉.zh: 请写信告诉我你们学校的情况。
告诉.pinyin: Qǐng xiě xìn gào su wǒ nǐ men xué xiào de qíng kuàng
告诉.en: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
告诉.es: Escríbeme, por favor, sobre la situación de tu colegio.

公司.zh: 他代表我们公司出席了会议。
公司.pinyin: Tā dài biǎo wǒ men gōng sī chū xí le huì yì
公司.en: He represented our company at the conference.
公司.es: Él representó a nuestra compañía en la conferencia.

Gōng sī wèi tā men tí gōng zhì fú
公司.en: The company provides them with uniforms.
公司.es: La empresa les proporciona los uniformes.

公司.es: Muchas pequeñas empresas entraron en bancarrota.

远.zh: 你的行为离要求的太远了。
远.pinyin: Nǐ de xíng wéi lí yāo qiú de tài yuǎn le
远.en: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.
远.es: Tu conducta deja bastante que desear.

远.zh: 我总是在离手不远的地方放一本字典。
远.pinyin: Wǒ zǒng shì zài lí shǒu bù yuǎn de dì fang fàng yī běn zì diǎn
远.en: I always keep a dictionary close at hand.
远.es: Siempre tengo un diccionario a la mano.

远.en: How far is it from here?

远.pinyin: Huǒ chē zhàn lí zhè lǐ bù yuǎn
远.en: The station is not far from here.
远.es: La estación no está lejos de aquí.

羊肉.pinyin: Nǐ men xiǎng chī jǐ chuàn kǎo yáng ròu

羊肉.pinyin: Nín xiǎng chī jǐ chuàn kǎo yáng ròu

羊肉.zh: 比起羊肉我更喜欢牛肉。
羊肉.pinyin: Bǐ qǐ yáng ròu wǒ gèng xǐ huan niú ròu
羊肉.en: I like beef more than lamb.

最后.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng zuì hòu yī qiè dōu hǎo
最后.en: I hope everything will be fine in the end.
最后.es: Espero que todo esté bien al final.

最后.zh: 我们能赶上最后一班火车。
最后.pinyin: Wǒ men néng gǎn shàng zuì hòu yī bān huǒ chē
最后.en: We were able to catch the last train.

最后.zh: 我会战斗到最后一口气。
最后.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhàn dǒu dào zuì hòu yī kǒu qì
最后.en: I will fight to the last breath.
最后.es: Voy a luchar hasta el último suspiro.

最后.pinyin: Zuì hòu tā méi yǒu lái
最后.en: After all she did not come.

图书馆.zh: 我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。
图书馆.pinyin: Wǒ hái le cóng tú shū guǎn jiè de shū yòu jiè le xiē xīn de
图书馆.en: I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
图书馆.es: Devolví los libros que había sacado de la biblioteca y me llevé prestados otros nuevos.

图书馆.zh: 他说的词典图书馆没有。
图书馆.pinyin: Tā shuō de cí diǎn tú shū guǎn méi yǒu
图书馆.en: The dictionary he talked about isn't available in the library.
图书馆.es: El diccionario del que él habló no está disponible en la biblioteca.

图书馆.zh: 美国的每个城市都有一个图书馆。
图书馆.pinyin: Měi guó de měi ge chéng shì dōu yǒu yī ge tú shū guǎn
图书馆.en: There is a library in every city in America.
图书馆.es: Hay una biblioteca en todas las ciudades de Estados Unidos.

图书馆.pinyin: Wǒ míng tiān qù tú shū guǎn wēn xí
图书馆.en: Tomorrow, I'm going to study at the library.
图书馆.es: Mañana iré a estudiar a la biblioteca.

甜.pinyin: Shì tián de hái shi suān de
Wǒ yào yī xiē tián de dōng xi

甜.zh: 我喝不下这么甜的咖啡。
甜.pinyin: Wǒ hē bù xià zhè me tián de kā fēi
甜.en: I can't drink coffee as sweet as this.
甜.es: No puedo tomarme un café con tanto azúcar.

甜.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chī diǎn tián de dōng xi
甜.en: I feel like eating something sweet.
甜.es: Tengo ganas de comer algo dulce.

聊天.zh: 在我开始聊天之前，我宁愿不说话。
聊天.pinyin: Zài wǒ kāi shǐ liáo tiān zhī qián wǒ nìng yuàn bù shuō huà
聊天.en: Before I start doing small talk, I'd rather not talk at all.
聊天.es: Antes de empezar a hacer la pequeña charla, preferiría no hablar en absoluto.

聊天.zh: 我们一直聊天直到天明。
聊天.pinyin: Wǒ men yī zhí liáo tiān zhí dào tiān míng
聊天.en: We talked and talked until the day broke.
聊天.es: Hablamos sin descanso hasta el amanecer.

聊天.pinyin: Tā men zhèng zài liáo tiān
Wǒ méi yǒu péng you kě yǐ liáo tiān
聊天.en: I have no friend to talk with.
聊天.es: No tengo un amigo con quien hablar.

东.zh: 不要对人家送的礼物挑三拣四，嫌东嫌西的。
东.pinyin: Bù yào duì rén jiā sòng de lǐ wù tiāo sān jiǎn sì xián dōng xián xī de
东.en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
东.es: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente.

东.zh: 我的记性怎么这么差，总是忘东忘西的！
东.pinyin: Wǒ de jì xing zěn me zhè me chà zǒng shì wàng dōng wàng xī de
东.en: Why is my memory so bad? I'm always forgetting things!

东.zh: 他们俩一个往东，一个往西。
东.pinyin: Tā men liǎ yī ge wǎng dōng yī ge wǎng xī
东.en: Of the two of them, one heads east and one heads west.

东.zh: 这不就是拆了东墙补西墙吗？
东.pinyin: Zhè bu jiù shì chāi le dōng qiáng bǔ xī qiáng ma
东.en: Isn't this just tearing down the east wall to repair the west wall?

完全.zh: 我完全记不起你的名字了。
完全.pinyin: Wǒ wán quán jì bù qǐ nǐ de míng zi le
完全.es: No me acuerdo de tu nombre en absoluto.

完全.zh: 她完全不担心测验的分数。
完全.pinyin: Tā wán quán bù dān xīn cè yàn de fēn shù
完全.en: She is not in the least worried about her test scores.
完全.es: Ella no está preocupada en lo más mínimo por su puntaje en la prueba.

完全.zh: 他完全沉浸于家庭生活中，不想工作了。
完全.pinyin: Tā wán quán chén jìn yú jiā tíng shēng huó zhōng bù xiǎng gōng zuò le
完全.en: He is totally immersed in family life and has no wish to work.
完全.es: Está totalmente sumergido en su vida familiar y no tiene deseos de trabajar.

完全.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de wán quán zhèng què
完全.en: All that you say is perfectly correct.
完全.es: Todo lo que dices es perfectamente correcto.

讨论.pinyin: Wǒ men tǎo lùn le nà ge wèn tí

讨论.zh: 让我们和他们讨论这个问题吧。
讨论.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men hé tā men tǎo lùn zhè ge wèn tí ba
讨论.en: Let's discuss the problem with them.

讨论.zh: 让我们马上讨论这个问题吧。
讨论.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men mǎ shàng tǎo lùn zhè ge wèn tí ba
讨论.en: Let's discuss the matter right now.

讨论.zh: 这个计划现在正在讨论中。
讨论.pinyin: Zhè ge jì huà xiàn zài zhèng zài tǎo lùn zhōng
讨论.en: This plan is being discussed right now.
讨论.es: Este plan está siendo discutido ahora mismo.

停.zh: 我能把我的车停在这儿吗？
停.pinyin: Wǒ néng bǎ wǒ de chē tíng zài zhèr ma
停.en: Could I park my car here?

停.zh: 你不能把你的车停在这里。
停.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng bǎ nǐ de chē tíng zài zhè lǐ
停.en: You can't park your car here.
停.es: No puedes aparcar tu coche aquí.

停.zh: 我们的火车突然停了下来。
停.pinyin: Wǒ men de huǒ chē tū rán tíng le xià lai
停.es: Nuestro tren se detuvo de repente.

出发.pinyin: Wǒ men míng tiān yī dà zǎo chū fā

浪费.pinyin: Nǐ bù gāi làng fèi nǐ de shí jiān
浪费.en: You should not waste your time.

浪费.en: I think of watching TV as a waste of time.
浪费.es: Pienso que mirar televisión es una pérdida de tiempo.

森林.pinyin: Tā zài sēn lín zhōng mí le lù

森林.es: Todos los días me paseo por el bosque.

森林.zh: 小男孩在森林中迷路了。
森林.pinyin: Xiǎo nán hái zài sēn lín zhōng mí lù le
森林.en: The boy lost his way in the forest.
森林.es: El chico se perdió en el bosque.

猜.pinyin: Nǐ néng cāi dào wǒ de nián líng ma

猜.pinyin: Nǐ néng cāi dào wǒ yǒu shén me ma
猜.en: Can you guess what I have here?

猜.zh: 我猜他们大多数回家了。
猜.pinyin: Wǒ cāi tā men dà duō shù huí jiā le
猜.en: I guess most of them went home.
猜.es: Supongo que la mayoría de ellos se fueron a casa.

表示.en: I thanked Mary for her help.

曾经.zh: 看来他曾经是个有钱人。
曾经.pinyin: Kàn lai tā céng jīng shì gè yǒu qián rén
曾经.en: He seemed to have been rich.

曾经.zh: 我曾经想过当个太空物理学家。
曾经.pinyin: Wǒ céng jīng xiǎng guò dàng gè tài kōng wù lǐ xué jiā
曾经.en: I once wanted to be an astrophysicist.

曾经.zh: 肯尼亚曾经是英国的殖民地。
曾经.pinyin: Kěn ní yà céng jīng shì yīng guó de zhí mín dì
曾经.en: Kenya used to be a British colony.
曾经.es: Kenia solía ser una colonia inglesa.

行动.zh: 时间不多，我们必须马上行动。
行动.pinyin: Shí jiān bù duō wǒ men bì xū mǎ shàng xíng dòng
行动.en: Time is short, we must act NOW.
行动.es: Hay poco tiempo, tenemos que actuar AHORA.

行动.en: I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
行动.es: Dejo en tus manos qué curso de acción tomar.

行动.zh: 行动比语言更有说服力。别发牢骚多做事。
行动.pinyin: Xíng dòng bǐ yǔ yán gèng yǒu shuō fú lì bié fā láo sāo duō zuò shì
行动.en: Actions speak louder than words. Stop complaining and do it.
行动.es: Acciones hablan más fuerte que las palabras. Deja de quejarte y hazlo.

建筑.zh: 那幢绿色屋顶的建筑是什么？

夜.en: I'd like to stay one more night. Is that possible?

分手.pinyin: Wǒ yào gēn nǐ fēn shǒu le

分手.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu xiǎng dào wǒ men huì zhè yàng fēn shǒu
分手.en: I never thought we'd end up like this.
分手.es: Nunca me imaginé que acabaríamos así.

分手.zh: 我觉得你应该跟男友分手。
分手.pinyin: Wǒ jué de nǐ yīng gāi gēn nán yǒu fēn shǒu
分手.en: I think that you should break up with your boyfriend.
分手.es: Creo que deberías romper con tu novio.

昆虫.zh: 他对收集昆虫很有兴趣。
昆虫.pinyin: Tā duì shōu jí kūn chóng hěn yǒu xìng qù

分别.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō méi shèn má fēn bié

分别.zh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。
分别.pinyin: Zǐ xì de bǐ jiào yī xià jiù huì fā xiàn liǎng zhě zhī jiān de fēn bié le
分别.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
分别.es: Compara ambos atentamente y verás la diferencia.

分别.zh: 假的钻石和真的钻石有甚么分别？
分别.pinyin: Jiǎ de zuàn shí hé zhēn de zuàn shí yǒu shèn má fēn bié
分别.en: What is the difference between imitation and real diamonds?
分别.es: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre los diamantes de imitación y los reales?

分别.zh: 你今天去和明天去也没有甚么分别。
分别.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān qù hé míng tiān qù yě méi yǒu shèn má fēn bié
分别.en: It makes no difference whether you go today or tomorrow.
分别.es: Da lo mismo si vas hoy o mañana.

说不定.zh: 你说不定知道他的名字？
说不定.pinyin: Nǐ shuō bu dìng zhī dào tā de míng zi
说不定.en: Do you happen to know his name?
说不定.es: ¿No sabrás por casualidad cuál es su nombre?

说不定.zh: 如果我运气够好的话，说不定会赢。
说不定.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ yùn qi gòu hǎo de huà shuō bu dìng huì yíng
说不定.en: I may win if I have luck.

说不定.zh: 谁能赢这场比赛还说不定。
说不定.pinyin: Shéi néng yíng zhè chǎng bǐ sài hái shuō bu dìng
说不定.en: It's still not certain who's going to win this match.
说不定.es: Todavía no está claro, quién vaya a ganar en este juego.

说不定.zh: 我一个月没见到小王了，他说不定已经回国了。
说不定.pinyin: Wǒ yī ge yuè méi jiàn dào xiǎo wáng le tā shuō bu dìng yǐ jīng huí guó le
说不定.en: I haven't seen Xiaowang for a month now; perhaps he's already gone back to his own country.

销售.zh: 公开此事会影响我们的销售，所以我们将忽略它一次。
销售.pinyin: Gōng kāi cǐ shì huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ men de xiāo shòu suǒ yǐ wǒ men jiāng hū lüè tā yī cì
销售.en: Making this matter public would have an effect on our sales, so we're going to overlook it this once.
销售.es: Hacer este asunto público tendría efecto sobre las ventas, así que vamos a pasarlo por alto por esta vez.

销售.pinyin: Jīn nián xiāo shòu huì fān fān
销售.es: Las ventas deberían duplicarse este año.

销售.pinyin: Shéi fù zé xiāo shòu bù mén
销售.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?
销售.es: ¿Quién está a cargo de la sección de ventas?

销售.zh: 在第三季时销售跌了下来。
销售.pinyin: Zài dì sān jì shí xiāo shòu diē le xià lai
销售.en: Sales fell off in the third quarter.

青春.pinyin: Qīng chūn zhǐ yǒu yī cì
青春.es: Sólo se es joven una vez.

青春.zh: 汤姆为自己浪费了大好的青春年华感到非常后悔。
青春.pinyin: Tāng mǔ wèi zì jǐ làng fèi le dà hǎo de qīng chūn nián huá gǎn dào fēi cháng hòu huǐ
青春.en: Tom regretted having wasted a great deal of his life.
青春.es: Tom lamentaba haber desperdiciado gran parte de su vida.

青春.zh: 当我们回眸青春，仿佛有一种说不出的痛。
青春.pinyin: Dāng wǒ men huí móu qīng chūn fǎng fú yǒu yī zhǒng shuō bu chū de tòng
青春.en: When we look back at our youth, there seems to be an indescribable pain.

青春.zh: 很多人问我，青春的诀别是否意味着年迈的将近。
青春.pinyin: Hěn duō rén wèn wǒ qīng chūn de jué bié shì fǒu yì wèi zhe nián mài de jiāng jìn
青春.en: A lot of people ask me whether bidding goodbye to youth means old age is near.

业务.zh: 不是的，他是我们的业务主管。
业务.pinyin: Bù shì de tā shì wǒ men de yè wù zhǔ guǎn

业务.zh: 我们需要改进我们的客服业务。
业务.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào gǎi jìn wǒ men de kè fú yè wù
业务.en: We need to improve our customer service.

业务.zh: 因为你们公司的业务能够发挥我的特长。
业务.pinyin: Yīn wèi nǐ men gōng sī de yè wù néng gòu fā huī wǒ de tè cháng
业务.en: Because your business can play to my strengths.

业务.zh: 他对他的新业务感到紧张。
业务.pinyin: Tā duì tā de xīn yè wù gǎn dào jǐn zhāng
业务.en: He was tense with his new business.

转变.zh: 科技的进步为我们的生活带来了巨大的转变。
转变.pinyin: Kē jì de jìn bù wèi wǒ men de shēng huó dài lái le jù dà de zhuǎn biàn
转变.en: The progress of science has brought about great change in our lives.
转变.es: Los progresos de la ciencia han aportado grandes cambios a nuestras vidas.

转变.zh: 人体能够快速地适应气温的转变。
转变.pinyin: Rén tǐ néng gòu kuài sù de shì yìng qì wēn de zhuǎn biàn
转变.en: The body quickly adjusts itself to changes in temperature.
转变.es: El cuerpo se adapta rápidamente a los cambios de temperatura.

转变.pinyin: Tā zhuǎn biàn le huà tí
转变.en: He changed the topic of conversation.

转变.zh: 由硬体到软体的转变是缓慢的。
转变.pinyin: Yóu yìng tǐ dào ruǎn tǐ de zhuǎn biàn shì huǎn màn de
转变.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.

会计.zh: 有可能将电脑工作扩展到银行业务, 会计业务等等。
会计.pinyin: Yǒu kě néng jiāng diàn nǎo gōng zuò kuò zhǎn dào yín háng yè wù kuài jì yè wù děng děng
会计.en: It's possible to branch out from computing to jobs in banking, accountancy and so on.

台阶.zh: 他俩的爱情，已经上升了一个台阶。
台阶.pinyin: Tā liǎ de ài qíng yǐ jīng shàng shēng le yī ge tái jiē
台阶.en: Their love has gone to the next level.

溜.pinyin: Tāng mǔ liū chū le jiào shì
溜.en: Tom slipped out of the classroom.
溜.es: Tom se escabulló de la sala de clases.

溜.zh: 我弟弟全身光溜溜地跑过客厅。
溜.pinyin: Wǒ dì di quán shēn guāng liu liū de páo guò kè tīng
溜.en: My little brother ran through the living room stark naked.
溜.es: Mi hermano pequeño cruzó el salón corriendo totalmente desnudo.

溜.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo chén liū gǒu
溜.en: He walks his dog every morning.
溜.es: Él pasea a su perro cada mañana.

溜.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
溜.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎo xīn de liū chū fáng jiān yǐ miǎn jīng xǐng tā
溜.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
溜.es: Salió sigilosamente de la habitación con mucho cuidado con el fin de evitar despertarla.

忠实.pinyin: Wǒ shì zú qiú de zhōng shí fěn sī
Gǒu shì zuì zhōng shí de péng you
忠实.en: A dog is the most devoted friend.

忠实.zh: 最慢的承诺永远是最忠实的信用。
忠实.pinyin: Zuì màn de chéng nuò yǒng yuǎn shì zuì zhōng shí de xìn yòng
忠实.en: The slowest promise is always the most faithful credit.

永恒.zh: 总有一些东西我永远不能学会，我的生命不是永恒的！
永恒.pinyin: Zǒng yǒu yī xiē dōng xi wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù néng xué huì wǒ de shēng mìng bù shì yǒng héng de
永恒.en: There will always be things I will never learn, I don't have eternity before me!
永恒.es: Siempre habrá cosas que nunca aprenderé, ¡no tengo toda la eternidad ante mí!

永恒.zh: 形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。
永恒.pinyin: Xíng shì shì zàn shí de děng jí cái shì yǒng héng de
永恒.en: Form is temporary, class is permanent.

永恒.zh: 凡美的事物就是永恒的喜悦。
永恒.pinyin: Fán měi dí shì wù jiù shì yǒng héng de xǐ yuè
永恒.en: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.

永恒.zh: 这些无限空间的永恒沉默使我恐惧。
永恒.pinyin: Zhè xiē wú xiàn kōng jiān de yǒng héng chén mò shǐ wǒ kǒng jù
永恒.en: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces terrifies me.

款式.zh: 款式很不错，不过有没有别的颜色？
款式.pinyin: Kuǎn shì hěn bù cuò bù guò yǒu méi yǒu bié de yán sè
款式.en: The style is nice, but do you have it in a different color?
款式.es: El estilo me gusta, pero ¿lo tienes en otro color?

款式.zh: 这种款式的帽子现在很流行。
款式.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kuǎn shì de mào zi xiàn zài hěn liú xíng
款式.en: This style of hat is now in fashion.
款式.es: Este estilo de sombrero está ahora de moda.

款式.zh: 三十年前的时装款式又流行起来了。
款式.pinyin: Sān shí nián qián de shí zhuāng kuǎn shì yòu liú xíng qǐ lai le
款式.en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.
款式.es: La moda de hace treinta años ha vuelto a estar de moda.

款式.zh: 今年流行甚么款式的外套？
款式.pinyin: Jīn nián liú xíng shèn má kuǎn shì de wài tào
款式.en: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?

铜.pinyin: Tóng hé yín dōu shì jīn shǔ
铜.en: Copper and silver are both metals.
铜.es: El cobre y la plata son dos metales.

铜.pinyin: Zhè bǎ tāng chí shì tóng zhì de
铜.en: This spoon is made of copper.

丰收.pinyin: Wǒ men qī wàng jīn nián fēng shōu
丰收.en: We're expecting a good harvest this year.
丰收.es: Este año esperamos una buena cosecha.

丰收.pinyin: Qù nián táo zi fēng shōu
丰收.en: There was a large harvest of peaches last year.
丰收.es: Hubo una gran cosecha de duraznos el año pasado.

丰收.pinyin: Yù qī jīn nián dào mǐ huì fēng shōu
丰收.en: This year promises a good harvest of rice.
丰收.es: Este año promete haber una buena cosecha de arroz.

动机.pinyin: Tā nà yàng zuò yǒu shèn má dòng jī
动机.en: What was his motive for doing it?

动机.pinyin: Tā shā rén de dòng jī shì shèn má
动机.en: What's his motive for committing murder?

动机.pinyin: Jí dù shì móu shā de dòng jī
动机.en: Jealousy was the motive for the murder.

回避.zh: 洋子回避我提出的问题。
回避.pinyin: Yáng zi huí bì wǒ tí chū de wèn tí
Bù yào huí bì wǒ de wèn tí

诞生.zh: 这个传统在中国诞生了。
诞生.pinyin: Zhè ge chuán tǒng zài zhōng guó dàn shēng le

诞生.zh: 我们是为了死亡而诞生的。
诞生.pinyin: Wǒ men shì wèi le sǐ wáng ér dàn shēng de

诞生.zh: 互联网的广泛应用使新一代的年轻人诞生了。
诞生.pinyin: Hù lián wǎng de guǎng fàn yìng yòng shǐ xīn yī dài de nián qīng rén dàn shēng le
诞生.en: The proliferation of Internet usage has given birth to a new generation of young people.

资本.pinyin: Jiàn kāng shì wǒ wéi yī de zī běn
资本.en: My health is my only capital.
资本.es: Mi salud es mi único capital.

资本.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào zī běn

资本.zh: 资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。
资本.pinyin: Zī běn tǔ dì hé láo dòng shì shēng chǎn de sān dà yào sù
资本.en: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.

资本.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
资本.pinyin: Gōng sī yóu yú quē fá zī běn dǎo bì le
资本.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.

踪迹.pinyin: Wǒ gēn zhe lù de zōng jì
踪迹.es: Seguimos las pistas dejadas por el venado.

踪迹.zh: 他消失了，不留一丝踪迹。
踪迹.pinyin: Tā xiāo shī le bù liú yī sī zōng jì
Liè rén gēn zhe xióng de zōng jì
踪迹.en: The hunter followed the bear's tracks.
踪迹.es: El cazador siguió las huellas del oso.

优异.zh: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
优异.pinyin: Tā yǐ yōu yì de chéng jì bì yè yú jiàn qiáo dà xué
优异.en: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.
优异.es: Él se graduó de Cambridge con honores.

优异.zh: 她取得了优异的英语成绩。
优异.pinyin: Tā qǔ dé le yōu yì de yīng yǔ chéng jì
优异.en: She gets good marks in English.

兜.zh: 他拉起帽兜，试图隐没在人群中。
兜.pinyin: Tā lā qǐ mào dōu shì tú yǐn mò zài rén qún zhōng
兜.en: He put up his hoodie and tried to disappear into the crowd.

凌晨.pinyin: Wǒ men liáo dào líng chén liǎng diǎn
凌晨.en: We talked until two in the morning.
凌晨.es: Conversamos hasta las dos de la mañana.

凌晨.zh: 凶杀案于凌晨三到五点间发生。
凌晨.pinyin: Xiōng shā àn yú líng chén sān dào wǔ diǎn jiān fā shēng
凌晨.en: The murder happened between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.
凌晨.es: El asesinato ocurrió entre las 3 y las 5 a.m.

新颖.zh: 许多网路公司为求生存而需要新颖的商业模式。
新颖.pinyin: Xǔ duō wǎng lù gōng sī wèi qiú shēng cún ér xū yào xīn yǐng de shāng yè mó shì
新颖.en: Many on-line companies need to have a new approach to business to survive.
新颖.es: Muchas compañías en internet necesitan tener un nuevo enfoque para que las empresas sobrevivan.

新颖.zh: 大家听了，都很高兴，觉得这个婚礼又新颖又有意义。
新颖.pinyin: Dà jiā tīng le dōu hěn gāo xìng jué de zhè ge hūn lǐ yòu xīn yǐng yòu yǒu yì yì
新颖.en: Everyone listened and was very happy, thinking this wedding was both original and meaningful.

途径.zh: 去那个村庄的唯一途径是过河。
途径.pinyin: Qù nà ge cūn zhuāng de wéi yī tú jìng shì guò hé
途径.en: The only access to the village is from the river.
途径.es: El único acceso al pueblo es desde el río.

途径.zh: 必须有外交解决的途径。
途径.pinyin: Bì xū yǒu wài jiāo jiě jué de tú jìng
途径.en: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
途径.es: Debe de haber una manera de llegar a una solución diplomática.

途径.zh: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。
途径.pinyin: Tā xún zhǎo yī qiè kě néng de táo shēng tú jìng
途径.en: He looked for every possible means of escape.

间隔.zh: 这间教室与那间隔着一堵墙。
间隔.pinyin: Zhè jiān jiào shì yǔ nà jiàn gé zhe yī dǔ qiáng
间隔.en: This classroom is separated from that one by a wall.
间隔.es: Esta sala de clases está separada de aquella por una pared.

间隔.zh: 在火车的间隔中有漫长的等待。
间隔.pinyin: Zài huǒ chē de jiàn gé zhōng yǒu màn cháng de děng dài
间隔.en: There is a long wait between trains.

间隔.pinyin: Tā jiàn gé le hěn jiǔ cái zuò dá
间隔.en: There was a long interval before he replied.

基金.zh: 该法案的说客把游说贿款汇入了竞选基金。
基金.pinyin: Gāi fǎ àn de shuì kè bǎ yóu shuì huì kuǎn huì rù le jìng xuǎn jī jīn
基金.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.

基金.zh: 他因滥用公共基金而被捕。
基金.pinyin: Tā yīn làn yòng gōng gòng jī jīn ér bèi bǔ
基金.en: He was arrested for abusing public funds.

开明.zh: 他一直都对他的未来事业保持着开明的心态。
开明.pinyin: Tā yī zhí dōu duì tā de wèi lái shì yè bǎo chí zhe kāi míng de xīn tài
开明.en: He always kept an open mind about his future career.

聚精会神.zh: 大家都在聚精会神地听着。
聚精会神.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zài jù jīng huì shén de tīng zhe

附和.pinyin: Wǒ yě nà yàng jué de tā fù hè dào
附和.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

隐约.zh: 透过薄雾，我隐约看见了我的未来。
隐约.pinyin: Tòu guò bó wù wǒ yǐn yuē kàn jiàn le wǒ de wèi lái
隐约.en: In looking through the mist, I caught a glimpse of my future.

隐约.zh: 她隐约地有一种的内疚感。
隐约.pinyin: Tā yǐn yuē de yǒu yī zhǒng de nèi jiù gǎn
隐约.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.

及早.pinyin: Jǐn kě néng jí zǎo bài fǎng nín
及早.en: I'll come as soon as I can.

无非.zh: 他无非是别人的跟屁虫。
无非.pinyin: Tā wú fēi shì bié ren de gēn pì chóng

窜.zh: 小偷迅速地窜入了人群。
窜.pinyin: Xiǎo tōu xùn sù de cuàn rù le rén qún
窜.en: The thief whipped out into the crowd.

昨晚.zh: 昨晚我的自行车被偷了。
昨晚.pinyin: Zuó wǎn wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi tōu le
昨晚.en: I had my bicycle stolen last night.

昨晚.zh: 昨晚我们听了总统在电视上的讲话。
昨晚.pinyin: Zuó wǎn wǒ men tīng le zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shàng de jiǎng huà
昨晚.en: Yesterday evening we heard the President talk on television.
昨晚.es: Anoche nosotros hemos escuchado las palabras del presidente en la televisión.

昨晚.zh: 昨晚他希望他去了剧场。
昨晚.pinyin: Zuó wǎn tā xī wàng tā qù le jù chǎng
昨晚.en: He wishes he had gone to the theater last night.
昨晚.es: Él desearía haber ido al teatro anoche.

昨晚.pinyin: Wèi shén me nǐ zuó wǎn shuì bù zháo
昨晚.en: Why couldn't you sleep last night?

成了.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ mén tú chéng le lǜ sè
成了.es: Hemos pintado de verde la puerta.

成了.pinyin: Wǒ hé mǎ lì chéng le hǎo péng you
成了.en: Mary and I became good friends.
成了.es: Mary y yo nos hicimos buenas amigas.

成了.zh: 他有三个儿子，全都成了音乐家。
成了.pinyin: Tā yǒu sān gèr zi quán dōu chéng le yīn yuè jiā
成了.en: He has three sons, who became musicians.
成了.es: Tiene tres hijos que se volvieron músicos.

成了.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā chéng le shú rén
成了.en: I struck up an acquaintance with her.

作.zh: 这外套是什么材料作的？
作.pinyin: Zhè wài tào shì shén me cái liào zuò de
作.en: What stuff is this jacket made of?
作.es: ¿De qué material está confeccionada esta chaqueta?

作.zh: 每天作一些练习是必须的。
作.pinyin: Měi tiān zuò yī xiē liàn xí shì bì xū de
作.en: It is necessary to take some exercise every day.
作.es: Es necesario hacer algo de ejercicio cada día.

作.pinyin: Nǐ yīng gāi zuò zuì huài de zhǔn bèi
作.en: You should prepare for the worst.
作.es: Te deberías preparar para lo peor.

作.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào bīng jī lín zuò tián diǎn
作.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

没办法.zh: 我的鼻子没办法呼吸了。
没办法.pinyin: Wǒ de bí zi méi bàn fǎ hū xī le
没办法.en: I can't breathe through my nose.
没办法.es: No puedo respirar por la nariz.

没办法.zh: 他们太吵了，我没办法集中精神了。
没办法.pinyin: Tā men tài chǎo le wǒ méi bàn fǎ jí zhōng jīng shén le
没办法.en: They're too noisy; I can't concentrate.
没办法.es: Son demasiado ruidosos, no puedo concentrarme.

没办法.zh: 你说得太轻了，以至于我没办法听清楚你在说什么。
没办法.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de tài qīng le yǐ zhì yú wǒ méi bàn fǎ tīng qīng chǔ nǐ zài shuō shén me
没办法.en: You speak so softly that I cannot quite hear what you say.
没办法.es: Hablas tan bajo que no puedo entender lo que dices.

没办法.zh: 这咖啡热得我没办法喝。
没办法.pinyin: Zhè kā fēi rè de wǒ méi bàn fǎ hē
没办法.en: This coffee is too hot for me to drink.
没办法.es: Este café esta demasiado caliente para que lo beba.

到家.zh: 那是在我到家以后，我才不见了我的钱包。
到家.pinyin: Nà shi zài wǒ dào jiā yǐ hòu wǒ cái bù jiàn le wǒ de qián bāo
到家.en: It was not until I reached home that I missed my purse.
到家.es: No fue sino hasta que llegué a casa que me di cuenta que me faltaba la cartera.

到家.zh: 我们才一到家就下起雨来了。
到家.pinyin: Wǒ men cái yī dào jiā jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le
到家.en: It started raining as soon as we got home.
到家.es: Empezó a llover en cuanto llegamos a casa.

到家.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài wǔ diǎn qián dào jiā
到家.en: I'd like to get home by five.
到家.es: Quisiera llegar a la casa a las cinco.

到家.zh: 他们在这个时候一定已经到家了。
到家.pinyin: Tā men zài zhè ge shí hou yī dìng yǐ jīng dào jiā le
到家.en: They must have arrived home by this time.
到家.es: Deben haber llegado a casa sobre esta hora.

餐馆.zh: 这是我知道的最好的餐馆。
餐馆.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zhī dào de zuì hǎo de cān guǎn
餐馆.en: This is the best restaurant I know of.
餐馆.es: Éste es el mejor restaurante que conozco.

餐馆.zh: 我吃不起这么贵的餐馆。
餐馆.pinyin: Wǒ chī bù qǐ zhè me guì de cān guǎn
餐馆.en: I can't afford to eat in such an expensive restaurant.
餐馆.es: No me puedo permitir comer en un restaurante tan caro.

餐馆.zh: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。
餐馆.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ tā dài dào xiào qū lǐ zuì guì de cān guǎn qù le
餐馆.en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
餐馆.es: Le llevé al restaurante más caro del campus.

餐馆.pinyin: Wǒ shòu gòu le zài cān guǎn chī fàn
餐馆.en: I'm fed up with eating in restaurants.
餐馆.es: Estoy harto de comer en restaurantes.

增长.zh: 在过去的五年里人口增长了一倍。
增长.pinyin: Zài guò qù de wǔ nián lǐ rén kǒu zēng zhǎng le yī bèi
增长.en: The population has doubled in the last five years.
增长.es: La población se ha duplicado en los últimos cinco años.

增长.pinyin: Qì chē de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng
增长.en: The number of cars is on the increase.

增长.zh: 人会随着年龄的增长而更加地玩世不恭。
增长.pinyin: Rén huì suí zhe nián líng de zēng zhǎng ér gèng jiā de wán shì bù gōng
增长.en: People grow more cynical with age.
增长.es: Con la edad la gente se vuelve más cínica.

增长.zh: 由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭在增长中。
增长.pinyin: Yóu yú zhū duō bù xìng yīn sù dān qīn jiā tíng zài zēng zhǎng zhōng
增长.en: Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.
增长.es: Debido a ciertas causas desventajosas, existe un aumento de familias donde solo existe un padre.

胜.pinyin: Shèng shēng chēng tā shì wú gū de
胜.en: Masaru claims that he is innocent.

胜.zh: 一个好邻居胜于一个遥远的朋友。
胜.pinyin: Yī ge hǎo lín jū shèng yú yī ge yáo yuǎn de péng you
胜.en: A good neighbour is better than a faraway friend.
胜.es: Vale más un buen vecino que un amigo lejano.

胜.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan xià tiān shèng yú dōng tiān
胜.en: I like summer better than winter.
胜.es: Me gusta más el verano que el invierno.

胜.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan jiù chē shèng yú xīn chē
胜.en: I like the old car more than the new.
胜.es: Me gusta más el coche viejo que el nuevo.

人民.pinyin: Zōng jiào shì rén mín de yā piàn
人民.en: Religion is the opiate of the masses.
人民.es: La religión es el opio del pueblo.

人民.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。
人民.pinyin: Kě lián de rén mín rèn píng cán bào de dú cái zhě chǔ zhì
人民.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
人民.es: La pobre gente estaba a la merced del cruel dictador.

人民.zh: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。
人民.pinyin: Zhōng guó rén mín zhèng zhì xié shāng huì yì de jiǎn chēng shì rén mín zhèng xié
人民.en: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".
人民.es: La abreviatura de "Conferencia Consultiva Política del Pueblo Chino" es "CCPPCh".

人民.zh: 中国政府控制了网络，以免让人民知道六四事件的真相。
人民.pinyin: Zhōng guó zhèng fǔ kòng zhì le wǎng luò yǐ miǎn ràng rén mín zhī dào liù sì shì jiàn de zhēn xiàng
人民.en: The Chinese government controlled the internet to prevent the people from knowing the truth of the Tiananmen Square Massacre.
人民.es: El gobierno chino controlaba internet para evitar que la gente supiera la verdad acerca de la masacre de la plaza de Tiananmen.

娜.pinyin: Wǒ wàng bu liǎo tǎ nī nà de liǎn
娜.es: No puedo olvidar el rostro de Taninna.

娜.zh: 我的生日是六月十二日。玛格达莲娜和我同年同日生。
娜.pinyin: Wǒ de shēng rì shì liù yuè shí èr rì mǎ gé dá lián nà hé wǒ tóng nián tóng rì shēng
娜.en: My birthday is June 12. Magdalena was born on the same day and year as me.
娜.es: Mi cumpleaños es el doce de junio. Magdalena nació el mismo día y el mismo año que yo.

娜.zh: 来吧，阿里亚娜号，不快点我们就永远到不了那儿!
娜.pinyin: Lái ba ā lǐ yà nà hào bù kuài diǎn wǒ men jiù yǒng yuǎn dào bù liǎo nàr
娜.en: Come on, Arianna, speed up or we'll never get there!
娜.es: ¡Vamos, Arianna, date prisa o no llegaremos nunca!

乘客.zh: 渡轮上的乘客不多于一百人。
乘客.pinyin: Dù lún shàng de chéng kè bù duō yú yī bǎi rén
乘客.en: There were not more than one hundred passengers on board the ferry.
乘客.es: No éramos más de cien pasajeros a bordo del ferry.

乘客.zh: 飞机开始震动的时候，乘客们都紧张了起来。
乘客.pinyin: Fēi jī kāi shǐ zhèn dòng de shí hou chéng kè men dōu jǐn zhāng le qǐ lai
乘客.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
乘客.es: Los pasajeros se pusieron nerviosos cuando el avión comenzó a vibrar.

乘客.pinyin: Huǒ chē lǐ jǐ mǎn le chéng kè
乘客.en: The train was full of passengers.
乘客.es: El tren estaba repleto de pasajeros.

乘客.zh: 这辆计程车载了两名乘客。
乘客.pinyin: Zhè liàng jì chéng chē zǎi le liǎng míng chéng kè
乘客.en: The taxi picked up two passengers.

多次.pinyin: Wǒ qù nà li hěn duō cì le
Wǒ zé bèi guo tā hěn duō cì le
多次.es: Le he llamado la atención muchas veces.

多次.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo guo tā hěn duō cì
多次.en: I have tried innumerable times to contact him.

多次.zh: 我们去过东京很多次了。
多次.pinyin: Wǒ men qù guo dōng jīng hěn duō cì le
多次.en: We have been to Tokyo many times.

醒来.pinyin: Wǒ cóng mèng zhōng xǐng lái

醒来.zh: 我醒来，发现原来一切都是场梦。
醒来.pinyin: Wǒ xǐng lái fā xiàn yuán lái yī qiè dōu shì chǎng mèng
醒来.en: I awoke to find everything had been a dream.
醒来.es: Desperté y descubrí que todo había sido un sueño.

醒来.zh: 我早上总是大约七点钟醒来。
醒来.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo shang zǒng shì dà yuē qī diǎn zhōng xǐng lái
醒来.en: In the morning I always wake up around seven o'clock.
醒来.es: En las mañanas siempre despierto alrededor de las siete.

醒来.zh: 当我醒来时，天正下着雪。
醒来.pinyin: Dāng wǒ xǐng lái shí tiān zhèng xià zhe xuě
醒来.en: When I awoke, it was snowing.

今早.zh: 如果我今早吃了早餐，现在肚子就不会这么饿了。
今早.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ jīn zǎo chī le zǎo cān xiàn zài dù zi jiù bù huì zhè me è le
今早.en: If I had eaten breakfast this morning, I would not be hungry now.
今早.es: Si yo hubiera desayunado esta mañana ahora no tendría hambre.

今早.pinyin: Nǐ jīn zǎo wèi shén me chí dào le
今早.en: Why were you late this morning?

今早.pinyin: Tā jīn zǎo shuì guò tóu le
今早.es: Él se quedó dormido esta mañana.

今早.zh: 我今早起床时天正在下雨。
今早.pinyin: Wǒ jīn zǎo qǐ chuáng shí tiān zhèng zài xià yǔ
今早.en: When I got up this morning, it was raining.
今早.es: Esta mañana cuando me levanté estaba lloviendo.

喜.zh: 我不知道你喜不喜欢她。
喜.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ xǐ bù xǐ huan tā
喜.en: I don't know whether you like her or not.
喜.es: No sé si ella te gusta o no.

喜.pinyin: Tā wèn wǒ xǐ bù xǐ huan shù xué
喜.en: He asked me whether I like math.
喜.es: Me preguntó si me gustan las matemáticas.

喜.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ bù xǐ huan méi guān xi
喜.en: Whether you like it or not doesn't matter.
喜.es: Da igual si te gusta o no.

喜.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ bù xǐ huan mǔ lì

注定.zh: 这样的计划注定会失败的。
注定.pinyin: Zhè yàng de jì huà zhù dìng huì shī bài de
注定.en: Such a plan is bound to fail.
注定.es: Un plan así está destinado a fallar.

注定.pinyin: Qīn lüè zhě zhù dìng yào bèi dǎ bài
注定.en: The aggressors are bound to be defeated.
注定.es: A los agresores solo les queda darse por vencidos.

注定.zh: 每个人都是注定要死的。
注定.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu shì zhù dìng yào sǐ de

分享.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ fēn xiǎng
分享.en: I want to share it with you.

分享.zh: 他和他所有的朋友分享了他的那盒饼干。
分享.pinyin: Tā hé tā suǒ yǒu de péng you fēn xiǎng le tā de nà hé bǐng gān
分享.en: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
分享.es: Compartió su caja de galletas con todos sus amigos.

分享.zh: 我不想和一个陌生人分享旅馆房间。
分享.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng hé yī ge mò shēng rén fēn xiǎng lǚ guǎn fáng jiān
分享.en: I don't want to share the hotel room with a stranger.
分享.es: No quiero compartir la habitación del hotel con un desconocido.

什么的.zh: 我本不该告诉您什么的。
什么的.pinyin: Wǒ běn bù gāi gào su nín shén me de
什么的.en: I shouldn't have told you anything.
什么的.es: No tendría que haberte dicho nada.

什么的.pinyin: Nǐ fù qīn shì zuò shén me de
Nǐ gū gu shì zuò shén me de

什么的.zh: 我们这周末应该干点什么的。
什么的.pinyin: Wǒ men zhè zhōu mò yīng gāi gān diǎn shén me de
什么的.en: We should do something this weekend.

取代.zh: 她对我来说无人可以取代。
取代.pinyin: Tā duì wǒ lái shuō wú rén kě yǐ qǔ dài

取代.zh: 在这个密码里，每个数字取代了一个字母。
取代.pinyin: Zài zhè ge mì mǎ lǐ měi ge shù zì qǔ dài le yī ge zì mǔ
取代.en: In this secret code, each number stands for a letter of the alphabet.
取代.es: En este código secreto, cada número representa a una letra del alfabeto.

取代.zh: 我无法取代她做英语老师。
取代.pinyin: Wǒ wú fǎ qǔ dài tā zuò yīng yǔ lǎo shī
取代.en: I can't take the place of her as an English teacher.
取代.es: No puedo sustituirla como profesor de inglés.

取代.zh: 因为空气污染的问题，也许有一天自行车会取代汽车。
取代.pinyin: Yīn wèi kōng qì wū rǎn de wèn tí yě xǔ yǒu yī tiān zì xíng chē huì qǔ dài qì chē
取代.en: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
取代.es: A causa del problema de la polución del aire, es posible que algún día la bicicleta reemplace al automóvil.

碎片.pinyin: Píng zi shuāi chéng le suì piàn
Huā píng shuāi chéng suì piàn le
碎片.en: The vase crashed and shattered into pieces.
碎片.es: El jarrón se quebró en pedazos.

碎片.zh: 看了信之后，她把它撕成碎片。
碎片.pinyin: Kàn le xìn zhī hòu tā bǎ tā sī chéng suì piàn
碎片.en: After she had read the letter, she tore it to pieces.
碎片.es: Después de leer la carta, la rompió en pedacitos.

碎片.pinyin: Tā bǎ xìn chéng suì piàn
碎片.en: She tore the letter into pieces.

脸色.zh: 你的脸色这么差，还是赶快去睡觉吧。
脸色.pinyin: Nǐ de liǎn sè zhè me chà hái shi gǎn kuài qù shuì jiào ba
脸色.en: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.
脸色.es: Pareces pálido. Sería mejor que te tumbaras en la cama de una vez.

脸色.zh: 凯特的脸色这么差，一定是生病了。
脸色.pinyin: Kǎi tè de liǎn sè zhè me chà yī dìng shì shēng bìng le
脸色.en: Kate must be sick, for she looks pale.

脸色.zh: 他的脸色变得十分苍白。
脸色.pinyin: Tā de liǎn sè biàn de shí fēn cāng bái

脸色.zh: 脸色这么差不要紧吗？要不还是去一趟医院比较好吧？
脸色.pinyin: Liǎn sè zhè me chà bù yào jǐn ma yào bù hái shi qù yī tàng yī yuàn bǐ jiào hǎo ba
脸色.en: Your face looks pale. Are you OK? Maybe it would be better if you went to the hospital, don't you think?

说说.zh: 给我说说你去过的一些地方。
说说.pinyin: Gěi wǒ shuō shuo nǐ qù guo de yī xiē dì fang
说说.en: Tell me about some of the places you've visited.
说说.es: Cuéntame acerca de algunos de los lugares a los que fuiste.

说说.zh: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。
说说.pinyin: Tāng mǔ de zhǔ yi wǒ bù tài gǎn xìng qù zhè ge wǒ men zhī jiān shuō shuo jiù hǎo
说说.en: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
说说.es: Entre tú y yo, la idea de Tom no me atrae demasiado.

说说.zh: 把我们想知道的都说说。
说说.pinyin: Bǎ wǒ men xiǎng zhī dào de dōu shuō shuo
说说.en: Now tell us what we want to know.

说说.zh: 你是不是有什么心事？来，跟我说说吧。
说说.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì yǒu shén me xīn shì lái gēn wǒ shuō shuo ba
说说.en: Is there something you want to get off your chest? Come on, you can tell me.

上天.zh: 上天会帮助自力更生的人。
上天.pinyin: Shàng tiān huì bāng zhù zì lì gēng shēng de rén
上天.en: Help yourself and God will help you.

上天.zh: 上天保佑，一切都会好起来。
上天.pinyin: Shàng tiān bǎo yòu yī qiè dū huì hǎo qǐ lai
上天.en: God willing, everything will be all right.

整整.pinyin: Tā jiǎng le zhěng zhěng yī xiǎo shí
整整.en: He talked for an entire hour.

整整.pinyin: Tā kū le zhěng zhěng yī wǎn
整整.es: No dejó de llover toda la noche.

整整.zh: 汤姆整整一个上午一句话也没说。
整整.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zhěng zhěng yī ge shàng wǔ yī jù huà yě méi shuō
整整.en: Tom hasn't said a word all morning.
整整.es: Tom no ha dicho una sola palabra en toda la mañana.

整整.zh: 我等我的朋友等了整整一小时。
整整.pinyin: Wǒ děng wǒ de péng you děng le zhěng zhěng yī xiǎo shí
整整.en: I've spent an entire hour waiting for my friend.

瓜.pinyin: Zhǒng guā de guā zhǒng dòu de dòu
瓜.en: As a man sows, so he shall reap.
瓜.es: Cuando un hombre siembra, él deberá recoger.

瓜.pinyin: Bǎ guā qiē chéng liù děng fēn
瓜.en: Cut the melon into six equal pieces.

厨艺.zh: 我的厨艺比不上我的母亲。
厨艺.pinyin: Wǒ de chú yì bǐ bù shàng wǒ de mǔ qīn
厨艺.en: I cannot cook as well as my mother does.
厨艺.es: No sé cocinar tan bien como mi madre.

厨艺.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiǎng niàn nǐ de chú yì
Wǒ mā ma de chú yì hěn hǎo
厨艺.en: My mother is a very good cook.
厨艺.es: Mi madre es una muy buena cocinera.

厨艺.pinyin: Tā nǚ ér de chú yì hěn chà
厨艺.en: Her daughter is bad at cooking.
厨艺.es: Su hija es mala para cocinar.

相互.pinyin: Wǒ men de ài shì xiāng hù de

相互.zh: 他们礼节性地相互打了个招呼。
相互.pinyin: Tā men lǐ jié xìng dì xiāng hù dá le gè zhāo hu

相互.zh: 有时候冰球运动员相互挑衅得太厉害以至于会引发斗殴。
相互.pinyin: Yǒu shí hou bīng qiú yùn dòng yuán xiāng hù tiǎo xìn de tài lì hai yǐ zhì yú huì yǐn fā dòu ōu
相互.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
相互.es: A veces, los jugadores de hockey se ponen tan peleoneros entre ellos que estallan peleas.

相互.zh: 狮子为了得到食物相互争斗。
相互.pinyin: Shī zǐ wèi le dé dào shí wù xiāng hù zhēng dòu
相互.en: The lions fought with each other to get food.

伊斯兰教.zh: 中国重要的宗教是道教、佛教、伊斯兰教和基督教。
